final_ios_adhoc.question: Set up ad-hoc distribution
final_ios_adhoc.text: Ad-hoc builds use their own provisioning profile and don't need an App Store Connect API key. The iOS guide walks through the ad-hoc profile and the --ios-distribution ad_hoc flag.

cta.text: 📖 Read the iOS guide — Ad-Hoc Distribution

final_ios_have.question: Save your existing credentials
final_ios_have.text: You already have your certificate and provisioning profile, so save them to Capgo directly. (Recommended for now when you bring your own iOS credentials.)
